First publication of the text used: 1920 (SE colophon: 'A Popular Schoolgirl was published in 1920 by Angela Brazil.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1920, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2015.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts; possible countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1947, so the work is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2018.
